citations.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
citations.title: Production: Crops and livestock products
citations.notice: This dataset provides annual statistics on crop and livestock production across countries and territories. For crops, data are provided on area harvested, production quantities and yields. For livestock, data are provided on animal stocks, numbers of producing and slaughtered animals, and the production of meat, milk, eggs and other livestock products. The dataset also includes information on production quantities for selected processed products, such as vegetable oils, sugar, fibres, beer, wine and major dairy products.
citations.credit: FAO. 2025. FAOSTAT: Production: Crops and livestock products (QCL). Accessed 2026-11-06. https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/QCL. Licence: CC BY 4.0.

method: Selected Kenya production (element 5510) and nine basket items. Preserved source flags and tonnes. Product compatibility follows the source-specific trade dictionary.
downstream: Retain FAO credit, domain notices, changes, CC BY 4.0 and additional FAO terms. No commercial promotion, misrepresentation or implied endorsement.
